decisions.reason: Building on the firm's established offer and having won an award, it strongly leverages existing knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate results and improve further.
Because it builds on the firm's established offer, the firm has relevant absorptive capacity to interpret early results and refine the product.
As a product line building on established offer, the firm can apply its existing surface technology knowledge to adapt and improve the models.
Although close to the established offer, fire-protection applications require some new knowledge, but the firm's steel profile expertise supports learning and improvement.
Close to the established offer, the firm can leverage its profile systems knowledge to interpret market feedback and enhance the product.
Building on the established offer in surface systems, the firm has the absorptive capacity to assimilate results and continue innovation.
